notes: Both quantifying chains 'all his servants' and 'all his land' are rendered attributively with no 'of', so rule 28 governs rather than rule 19, and each possessive is the suffix's under rule 18.
Each article in 'the signs and the wonders' has a written 'the' of its own (rule 15).
לַעֲשׂוֹת: the written 'to' is the preposition's (rule 52).
